neutral_facts.value: The accused, who was an agriculturist, murdered his step mother during agricultural operations in a field. The accused told his step sister that he had strangled and killed the victim. He later made an extra-judicial confession to a Village Administrative Officer, which was recorded in writing. A rope used for strangulation was recovered. The victim's body was found in a decomposed state, and the post-mortem examination indicated that the cause of death was asphyxia due to strangulation. The medical evidence supported the ocular evidence, and the accused had prepared for the act by hiding the rope in the field. The trial court convicted the accused for life imprisonment under Section 302 of the IPC, and the High Court upheld the conviction.

prosecution_argument.value: The appellant committed the murder of his step mother. He told his step sister that he had strangled and killed her. He made an extra-judicial confession to the Village Administrative Officer, which led to the recovery of the rope used for strangulation. The medical evidence supported the ocular evidence, and the father and brother-in-law of the accused turning hostile did not affect the prosecution case.

defence_argument.value: The conviction was based solely on an extra-judicial confession, which is weak evidence. The FIR was recorded later than the confession, and the medical evidence suggested the incident occurred before 11 a.m., contradicting the prosecution's timeline.

quotes.text: It has been argued that the conviction of the appellant only on the basis of the extra judicial confession was not called for in the light of the fact that PW2 the father of the appellant, his sister PW5 and her husband PW3 had turned hostile and had not supported the prosecution.

legal_principle_applied.value: The court applied the principle that an extra-judicial confession can be considered valid if it is made promptly, without attempts to flee, and supported by other evidence. The court also emphasized the importance of medical evidence in supporting the prosecution's case.

quotes.text: It is of significance that the appellant had made the extra judicial confession to PW5 and thereafter to PW1 within a very short time and had not attempted to run away and he had been handed over to the police by PW1 at about 6 p.m. at the time when the FIR had been recorded.

sentencing_rationale.value: The final sentence was imposed because the prosecution's case was supported by the extra-judicial confession, the recovery of the rope, and the medical evidence, which confirmed the cause of death as strangulation.

quotes.text: For the reasons mentioned above, we endorse the findings of the High Court and the trial court and dismiss the appeal.
